steps.description: Meet Rebecca, Dean of the Aionians.
Draw out the Barricade Mind to obtain the Acceleron it guards.
Access the terminal to acquire the translation cipher "Rosetta."
Return to Dean Rebecca with the Rosetta technology and attempt another conversation.
Access the Aionians's telemetry buoys to locate the disruptive signal.
Meet with Orin.
Access the Altar of Relativity to begin tracking down the lost strangelet capsules.
Visit the Altar of Relativity to begin tracking strangelet capsules in the Central Academy and Exile's Accord.
Recover strangelet capsules across Kepler and return them to the Altar of Relativity.
The strangelet capsule is ready for integration. Return to the Altar and perform the integration.
Restore Power to the Altar of Relativity.
The strangelet capsule is ready for integration. Return to the Altar and perform the integration.
Meet Drifter in the Caldera.
Acquire the strangelet capsule located in Central Academy.
Locate and acquire the strangelet capsule located in Exile's Accord.
Integrate the Central Academy strangelet capsule at the Altar of Relativity.
Integrate the Exile's Accord strangelet capsule at the Altar of Relativity.
Access the Altar of Relativity to begin tracking the stranglet capsule in Outer Steppes.
Locate and acquire the strangelet capsule from Outer Steppes.
Integrate the strangelet capsule from Outer Steppes at the Altar of Relativity. Then only one remains.
Meet with Lodi and Ikora at the Altar of Relativity.
Access the Altar of Relativity to begin tracking the stranglet capsule in The Gorge.
Locate and acquire the strangelet capsule from The Gorge.
Speak with Orin in the Assimilated Easement.
Complete mission "Criticality" to shut down the overloading reactors and save the Aionian settlement from obliteration.
Integrate the strangelet capsule from The Gorge into the Altar of Relativity.
Meet with Lodi and Orin near the Altar.
Complete mission "The Message."
Meet with Lodi and your fireteam to discuss what you've learned.
Meet with Lodi in the Caldera to discuss his intel.
Examine the Altar's new state.
Locate the Emeritus in the Aionian Campus to obtain more information about the strangelet capsule there.
Find a way into the Aionian laboratory to rescue the scientists held there and obtain the Acceleron.
Let the Emeritus know that you have saved his researchers.
Push back the assault on the Aionian Agricultural Center.
Let the Emeritus know the problem at the Agricultural Center has been resolved.
Speak with Dean Rebecca in the Aionian Campus.
Protect the Aionian holy site.
Talk to the Emeritus in the Aionian Campus.
Speak with the dean in the Aionian Campus regarding the Vex.
Retrieve the strangelet capsule from its resting place, which is currently overrun by Vex.
Meet Lodi in the Curtilage Divide within the Exile's Accord.
Engage the Exiles to acquire the Relocator tech and the Acceleron held by the Exile commander here.
Meet with Lodi.
Sabotage the House of Exile's Arc refinery operations.
Locate Lodi in Augur's Bethel.
Acquire the Acceleron from Spoil to access mission "Saturnism."
Destroy the Exiles' Prime Servitor and claim the House's strangelet capsule.
Find and speak with Orin in the Gorge.
Clear a path to the final strangelet capsule by destroying the Vex Minds that refine the Nine's power and shield the collective from degradation.
Defeat the Vex Mind maintaining the quarantine around the Acceleron and retrieve the strangelet capsule it holds.
Ikora wants you to investigate the relationship between dark matter and Kepler, but first she needs you to meet up with Lodi's Aionian contact in the Stacks.
Dr. Carnahan's office has been ransacked. Trace amounts of of Stasis and Strand energy hang in the air. Find the culprits, and maybe the Dr.
Track down the last of the Exiles who ransacked the lab and claim the leader's Acceleron.
Talk to Dr. Carnahan about the murder of her assistant.
Find the murderer. Exact justice and retrieve the stolen technology.
Return to Dr. Carnahan with the Mattermorph technology.
Retrieve the Outer Steppes strangelet capsule in mission "Charge."
Scour the area for information.
Return the strange device you found to the Aionian encampment in the Caldera.
You have the unstable artifact, and Dean Rebecca has asked that you return to her in the Caldera.
Void signals indicate the locations of the microscopic singularities. Find and destroy them.
The singularities are being caused by axion bolts. Destroy them to prevent further singularity development.
Another axion-bolt-created singularity remains to be destroyed.
One final set of readings remains. Track them down.
Defend the Ares One against the encroaching Vex.
Use your basic understanding of the Aionian language to converse with the Aionian researcher.
You're told there is a monument here that carries great importance to the Aionians. Find it and learn what you can from it.
Speak with Dean Rebecca to learn more about the Aionians and how you can help.
Collect samples of the local Vex for the Aionians' studies.
Return the Vex samples to the Aionian researcher as requested.
Speak with Ghost.
An offline terminal in House of Exile territory holds data that could be valuable to the Aionians.
Return to Ikora to speak with her about everything that's happened.
Locate and investigate Temporal Disturbances across Kepler that are being tampered with by the Conductor's Vex.
Ikora found a strange relic and requests your presence immediately. Meet with her to investigate further.
Locate and scan the next disturbance site.
Ghost is detecting a Vanguard signal. Establish contact with Ikora Rey and hear what she has to say.
Ikora has forwarded the coordinated of a number of Vex data spikes. Lodi's been bouncing signals off of them. Find them, and pull the data.
Now that the Vex lures are deciphered, Lodi is trying to contact you. Find a clear signal and answer his call.
Seek out vestiges of the Nine's presence across Kepler.
Locate a second group of symbols of the Nine.
Locate a third group of symbols of the Nine.
Locate a fourth group of symbols of the Nine.
Bind your connections with the Nine to the Orrery.
Investigate the time scars Lodi has located.
Investigate the next time scar Lodi has located.
One time scar remains to investigate.
Destroy the Vex hunting after a strange signal.
Examine the remaining wreckage of Vex.
This particular Vex seems well-mannered. For now. Search the area for clues about its provenance.
The Vex arrive once again. They want what you carry. Defeat them!
Return Sharp Cheddar to Dean Rebecca.
Lodi's voice channel is being overloaded with some kind of strange interference, but his signal is pinging your comms. Search for a spot with a clearer signal and contact him.
Search for a signature that might indicate Lodi's presence by inspecting the House of Exile corpses coated in strange energy.
Search the area for anything of relevance to Lodi's strange experience.
Find another slime in order to reach back to the Archon. Hopefully it can be stopped from impacting Lodi.
Use the resonance of the energy point to attract the Archon's attention.
A nearby radiolaria pool contains strange dark matter signatures. Investigate it and see what knowledge can be gleaned.
A Vex ambush protects the pool. Destroy the attackers and find what secrets they're guarding.
Ikora suspects there is a life form, maybe a plant, that may be actively feeding off of the dark matter. She surmises that we might be able to find a specimen in the Caldera.
Ghost is tracking a concentration of dark matter traces. They converge in the Stacks, near where you landed.
The Aionians have a Shrine to Failure nearby. Perhaps it holds a clue to the Aionian's history.
Defeat Vex in the area to collect radiolaria specimens for the temporal beacon.
Orin needs you to plant the completed beacon to act as a temporal antenna. She means to show something to Lodi.
Orin is pinging you on a private channel. Pinpoint the signal and connect to her call.
Your attempts to tap into Unknown Space have drawn in Vex of the Nessian Schism. Remove them.
Return to Orin to speak with her.
Continue helping Orin recover fragments of herself across Kepler.
There is more of Orin's past to uncover, deeper within Kepler.
Track down the remnants of Orin's Ghost, Gol.
Orin needs your help finding Lodi before the Vex do.
There is a faint bio-signature on the telescope. Maybe Lodi was here.
Starting at the North Star, Outline the constellation Ursa Major.
Outline the constellation Orion, the Hunter.
Orin is calling back into the comms line for an update. Find a safe spot to speak.
Mysterious chess pieces may have some relation to the Aionians's history. Maybe an Aionian historian will know more.
The chess pieces are long-lost correspondences to Earth! The Aionians have asked you to find more, if you can.
You've found another encoded chess piece, but it's significance is unclear.
The historian believes the chess pieces provide insight into how Aionian society came to be. They've has asked you to collect more lost correspondences from across Kepler.
You've collected the remainder of the lost correspondences. Return the completed collection to Dean Rebecca.
Collect strangelet capsules in World Tier: Fabled and integrate them at the Altar of Relativity.
Defeat the Archon in World Tier: Fabled.
Collect strangelet capsules in World Tier: Mythic and integrate them at the Altar of Relativity.
Defeat the Archon in World Tier: Mythic.
Visit Dean Rebecca on Kepler.
Complete the raid.
Approach the Simulant Ansible within the Nursery.
Use your network proximity sensor to identify areas where simulations converge.
Search for convergences to add to Maya and Chioma's data set.
Maya and Chioma signal you back to the communications hub in the Nursery.
Speak to Lodi.
Speak with the Emeritus in the Caldera.
Triangulate the location of the weapon piece using the Rosetta device in the Outer Steppes.

objectives.label: Department of External Observations weapon piece located

steps.description: Find the lost Department of External Observations weapon piece within the search area.
Speak with the Emeritus in the Caldera.
Triangulate the location of the weapon piece using the Rosetta device in the Gorge.

objectives.label: Department of External Observations weapon piece located

steps.description: Find the lost Department of External Observations weapon piece within the search area.
Speak with Lodi in the Caldera.
Triangulate the location of the weapon piece using the Rosetta device in Exile's Accord.
Find the lost Department of External Observations weapon piece within the search area.
Speak with the Emeritus in the Caldera.
Collect Data Fragments from defeated Vex. More powerful Vex will provide more data.
Find the lost Department of External Observations weapon piece within the search area.
Speak to Lodi.
Assemble the weapon using the Sieve.
